spec.engine_series: wide monthly return minus ladder monthly return
spec.decomposition: every day's w*r is booked per (month, symbol) inside e27.simulate (contrib seam) for BOTH books, then net = wide - ladder; a name held by both books nets out, the cash residual keeps __cash__
spec.units: annualised bp of the era (mean monthly x 12 x 1e4)
spec.flip_test: drop the biggest carrier (and the top set) from BOTH arms' engine levels and re-read the era sign verdict

pre2017.carriers_note: the engine level is identical on both arms for this era, so there is no delta to attribute

2017_2020.carriers_note: the engine level is identical on both arms for this era, so there is no delta to attribute

honest: the decomposition is arithmetic, not a story: contributions are the same w*r terms the engine curve compounds, so the named carriers plus the residual reconstruct the published delta
the residual is quoted per era because daily compounding inside a month is not additive; a residual near zero is expected and a large one means the attribution is broken
a single-name share above 50% is a disclosure, not a defect: it says the era's move is one name-month, which a reader must know before quoting the era
dropping a carrier is a counterfactual, not a repair: the published engine levels are untouched
the ladder leg is a fixed 5-name book, so a name that appears in both books contributes only the difference of its two weights
2024_now: the named carriers add to 49.6bp against a 46.7bp delta, so the residual is quoted, not zeroed
